items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms of ringed spaces f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z there is a canonical distinguished triangle Lf^*L_{Y/Z} -> L_{X/Z} -> L_{X/Y} -> Lf^*L_{Y/Z}[1] in D(O_X) (source lines 3763-3771). The proof sets h = g o f, records the identification of the pullback of the structure sheaf, and uses the pullback statement for the cotangent complex to write f^{-1}L_{Y/Z} as the cotangent complex of the map of sheaves of rings h^{-1}O_Z -> f^{-1}O_Y, which is a complex of flat f^{-1}O_Y-modules; the triangle is then an instance of the sheaf-theoretic triangle lemma for the three sheaves of rings.
